summary: Iteration 2 tested 4 new features + regression on Vocably. Backend: 33/33 pytest cases pass, including all new endpoints (entitlements shape+limits, subscription activate/cancel round-trip, word-bank scale 230 words with cefr+exam filters, /words/{id}/audio Dictionary+TTS fallback, /api/tts/{key}.mp3 serves audio/mpeg 200 with real mp3 payload, AI Coach generates+caches via gpt-5.6-luna with 3/day free-tier limit enforced returning 402 on 4th unique word, cached words don't count, GRE locked=true + /practice/start?source=exam&ref=gre returns 402 for free user, unlocks after subscription/activate). Regression: mission free new_count<=8, practice start/answer/complete, all prior 22 tests still pass. Frontend: word detail shows Listen button (functional), 'Explain this with AI' generates and renders Explanation/Fresh example/Memory hook inline; synonym/antonym related chips render with testID related-chip-<headword>; Profile shows Upgrade-to-Pro button; paywall opens with plan-monthly/plan-yearly selectors and Start-Pro subscribe-button; subscribe API succeeds (Profile then shows 'Vocably Pro · Active' and GRE unlocks with Start Practice CTA visible). One minor UX bug: after Start-Pro on the paywall page, the paywall itself does NOT re-render its Pro state (cancel-pro-button doesn't appear until you leave and re-enter the paywall) - refreshUser succeeds and other screens update, but paywall.tsx isn't re-subscribing to the user state change. Deprecated packages detected: none in this iteration (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch not present). Deprecated style props still emit warnings: shadow* and pointerEvents (unchanged from iter 1).

minor.issue: Limit hard-capped at 100 (le=100 in Query). Not a bug but tests need pagination via offset to sweep the 230-word bank.

ui_bugs.issue: After tapping Start Pro on the paywall, the page does not re-render its Pro state — cancel-pro-button is not shown until the user navigates away and comes back. activate() calls refreshUser() but the paywall reads user?.tier at first render and does not react to the auth-store update. Repro: /paywall -> Start Pro -> stay on page -> still shows Start Pro. Workaround: navigate back to Profile (which shows 'Vocably Pro · Active') then reopen paywall — cancel-pro-button then appears.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Reference: numerous StyleSheet.create() blocks.

action_items: Make paywall.tsx reactive to the auth store: subscribe to user via useAuth() and derive isPro from that (not from a snapshot), or await refreshUser and then rely on the re-render. Currently the page persists Start-Pro after successful activation.
(carry-over) Migrate deprecated shadow* style props to boxShadow and pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents for React Native web.
(carry-over) Fix Profile stats grid single-character-per-line layout bug reported in iter 1.

rca_of_issue: Paywall Pro-state stale render: app/paywall.tsx line 42 reads `const isPro = user?.tier === 'pro'` from an auth hook. After tapping Start Pro, activate() calls the mock subscription API + refreshUser(), which updates the user object in the auth store. If the paywall is memoizing or if useAuth() doesn't return a live subscription, isPro doesn't flip. Fix: ensure useAuth() returns a subscribed value (e.g. Zustand selector) and/or reset local state on user change via useEffect(() => {}, [user?.tier]).
